package.name: rosidl_typesupport_xcdr_c
package.description: Language-agnostic outer callback ABI for XCDR-based typesupport. Defines a pure-C callback table with opaque inner state that each language-specific XCDR typesupport (C, C++, Python) implements. Generic trampoline functions dispatch through the callback table so middleware can manage any XCDR typesupport identically.
